## Episode Thesis

This Norwegian personal-finance episode (VG's Pengeradet) sets SSB data showing stronger purchasing power against a SpareBank 1 survey in which about 400,000 mortgage holders say they can barely handle another rate hike. The host argues that such surveys paint households' finances darker than they are, and walks through a personal stress test covering rate hikes, fund concentration, job loss, income drops and disability cover. On markets, the hosts point to AI-driven turbulence and the heavy AI and tech weighting in global index funds. They recommend rebalancing away from tech and gradually de-risking if you need the money soon, but give no buy or sell calls on individual stocks.
